issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Video Agent by Fotor
products.tagline: Create and edit precision motion graphics & video with chat
products.summaryZh: 使用聊天创建和编辑精确的动态图形与视频。
products.descriptionZh: Fotor Video Agent帮助创始人、营销人员和创作者将创意、脚本或原始素材转化为精准视频和动态图形。它自动编排场景、时间、视觉特效和动态文字，同时在渲染前保持多轨时间轴上的文本、数字、标志和图表可编辑。最后一刻更新数据或调整时间，无需重新生成整个视频。更快交付宣传片和讲解视频，无黑箱输出，也无需繁琐的关键帧操作。
products.description: Fotor Video Agent helps founders, marketers, and creators turn ideas, scripts, or raw assets into precision videos & motion graphics. It auto-orchestrates scenes, timing, visual FX, and kinetic typography—while keeping text, numbers, logos, and charts editable on a multi-track timeline before you render. Update stats at the last minute or refine timing without regenerating the whole video. Ship promos and explainers faster with zero black-box outputs and no tedious keyframes.

products.name: BrandJet
products.tagline: Turn public buying signals into sales pipeline
products.summaryZh: 将公开的购买信号转化为销售管道
products.descriptionZh: BrandJet将实时购买信号转化为外呼管道。它在X、Reddit、LinkedIn及开放网络上监听人们提出的、您能解决的问题，将每个相关信号充实为潜在客户，并在他们实际使用的渠道上触达。从首个信号到外联、统一收件箱、CRM及签署合同，BrandJet在一个平台内运行整个流程。它通过MCP开放接口，使AI代理也能操作。
products.description: BrandJet turns live buying signals into outbound pipeline. It listens across X, Reddit, LinkedIn, and the open web for people asking about problems you solve, enriches every relevant signal into a lead, and reaches them on the channels they actually use. From first signal to outreach, unified inbox, CRM, and signed contract, BrandJet runs the entire motion in one platform. It's exposed through MCP so AI agents can run it too.

products.name: Interactive Sessions by Revolte
products.tagline: Drive the full SDLC with AI agents, step by step
products.summaryZh: 使用AI代理逐步驱动完整的软件开发生命周期
products.descriptionZh: 不同的工作对AI监督有不同的需求，Revolte两者兼备。我们的交互式会话让您逐步与智能体共同驱动完整生命周期：架构、代码、测试、预发布、部署，每一步都需您批准。自动驾驶模式则端到端处理Jira工单，智能体负责规划、编码、开启PR并部署。同一工作空间，同一治理体系：计划审批、内联差异、成本上限和审计追踪，均内置其中。需要控制时亲力亲为，无需时放手不管。
products.description: Different work needs different AI oversight, and Revolte gives you both. Our Interactive Sessions let you drive the full lifecycle with the agents, step by step: architecture, code, tests, staging, deploy. You approve every step. Autopilot mode hands off a Jira ticket end-to-end, with agents planning, coding, opening the PR, and deploying. Same workspace, same governance: plan approval, inline diffs, cost caps, and audit trails, built in. Hands-on when you want control, hands-off when you don't.

products.name: Tether
products.tagline: A ball for boring meetings to keep you busy
products.summaryZh: 无聊会议解闷球，让你忙个不停
products.descriptionZh: 一个弹性绳拴着的小球悬挂在你的Mac菜单栏上。拖动它、甩动它、弹射它。它会从你的实际应用窗口上弹开，沿着窗口边缘滚动，最后落入Dock中。剪断绳子，它就在桌面上自由滚动。真实的物理效果，而非预设动画，因此每次行为都独一无二。一键隐藏，当有人叫你的名字时瞬间消失。无需账户，无需订阅，所有数据都不离开你的Mac。
products.description: A ball hangs from your Mac menu bar on an elastic tether. Drag it, fling it, slingshot it. It bounces off your actual app windows, rolls along their edges and settles into the Dock. Cut the rope and it goes loose across the desktop. Real physics, not a canned animation, so it never does the same thing twice. One key hides it the instant somebody says your name. No account, no subscription, nothing leaves your Mac.

products.name: Ask My Wardrobe
products.tagline: The complete digital wardrobe experience
products.summaryZh: 完整的数字衣橱体验
products.descriptionZh: Ask My Wardrobe是一款AI穿搭生成与规划工具，让穿衣搭配更轻松、造型规划更合理、购物更有信心。利用你已有的衣物打造新造型，提前数天或数周规划穿搭，并在购买前虚拟试穿，减少在不常穿衣物上的浪费。保存你的最佳造型，与朋友分享并获取反馈，无需注册即可免费使用。
products.description: Ask My Wardrobe is an AI outfit generator and outfit planner that makes it easier to get dressed, plan better looks, and shop with more confidence. Use clothes you already own to build new outfits, plan what to wear days or weeks ahead, and virtually try on clothes before you buy so you waste less money on things you won’t wear. Save your best looks, share them with friends for feedback, and use it free with no sign-up required.

products.name: BrandMyLaptop
products.tagline: Sell ad space on your laptop
products.summaryZh: 在你的笔记本电脑上出售广告位
products.descriptionZh: 一个品牌购买你笔记本电脑外壳贴纸位的市场。设定你的机型、价格和条款。无论是Mac还是PC，无论是自购还是公司报销。
products.description: A marketplace where brands buy sticker spots on your laptop lid. Set your machine, your prices, your terms. Mac or PC, one you own or one the sales pay for.

products.name: Orato
products.tagline: Practice speaking with AI.
products.summaryZh: 使用AI练习口语。
products.descriptionZh: 选择一个练习，进行30到90秒的演讲，系统会根据节奏、流利度、词汇和连贯性进行评分。每个填充词和长时间停顿都会记录在可回看的文稿中。在配备Apple Intelligence的iPhone上，它完全在设备端运行，无需账户。
products.description: Pick a drill, speak for 30 to 90 seconds, and get scored on pacing, fluency, vocabulary and coherence. Every filler and long pause lands on a transcript you can read back. On an iPhone with Apple Intelligence it runs on the device, with no account.

products.name: Radar by Particle
products.tagline: The Podcast Search Engine
products.summaryZh: 播客搜索引擎
products.descriptionZh: 网络可以搜索，播客也应如此。今天，Particle推出Radar，一款播客搜索引擎。播客中蕴含着当下最深刻、最及时的对话，但这些知识难以寻觅。Radar可搜索超过13万个持续转录的播客，每天新增约2万集。数百万小时、数十亿行内容，全部可搜索。Radar由Particle的Podcast Intelligence API驱动，该API允许代理通过API/MCP跨播客进行搜索。
products.description: The web is searchable. Podcasts should be too. Today, Particle is introducing Radar, the podcast search engine. Podcasts hold some of the most thoughtful and timely conversations happening right now, but that knowledge is hard to find. Radar searches 130,000+ actively transcribed podcasts, with ~20,000 new episodes daily. Millions of hours and billions of lines, fully searchable. Radar is powered by Particle’s Podcast Intelligence API, which allows agents to search across podcasts via API/MCP.

products.name: FrameOS
products.tagline: Record your iOS & Android screen from your Mac.
products.summaryZh: 在Mac上录制iOS和Android屏幕。
products.descriptionZh: 在Mac上录制iPhone、iPad和Android应用演示。添加摄像头、麦克风、转场、缩放和遮罩，然后导出精美的视频和截图。
products.description: Record iPhone, iPad and Android app demos on your Mac. Add camera, mic, transitions, zooms and masks, then export polished videos and screenshots.

products.name: WebTerm Learn
products.tagline: Learn the terminal like a game — in a browser sandbox
products.summaryZh: 像玩游戏一样学习终端——在浏览器沙盒中
products.descriptionZh: 一个用于学习终端、Git和Vim的互动平台。手绘幻灯片讲解概念；真实的浏览器内沙盒检查你输入的每条命令。在3D世界地图上推进进度，伴随一个不断进化的伙伴。12门课程，129节课，全部免费。
products.description: An interactive platform for learning the terminal, Git, and Vim. Hand-drawn slides teach the concept; a real in-browser sandbox checks every command you type. Progress across a 3D world map with a companion that evolves. 12 courses, 129 lessons, all free.

products.name: StackScope
products.tagline: See what new sites are built with, the week they launch
products.summaryZh: 看看本周新上线的网站都用了哪些技术
products.descriptionZh: 查看本周哪些网站开始使用Stripe、Shopify或Next.js。我们索引的大部分内容都是自行发现的：来自公共基础设施信号的220多万个网站，并非用户提交，覆盖40,000多项技术。当我们在公告板之前捕捉到发布动态时，平均提前14.5天。浏览免费。付费套餐增加Stackdar提醒、API访问、含公开联系方式的批量导出，以及适用于Claude、ChatGPT和Cursor的MCP服务器。
products.description: See which sites started using Stripe, Shopify or Next.js this week. Most of what we index we find ourselves: over 2.2+ million sites from public infrastructure signals, not submitted to us, across 40,000+ technologies. When we reach a launch before the boards, we're 14.5 days early. Browsing is free. Paid plans add Stackdar alerts, API access, bulk export with published contact details, and an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor.

products.name: LeaseBase
products.tagline: AI that tells landlords what to do, not just what happened
products.summaryZh: AI不仅告知房东发生了什么，更指导他们如何应对。
products.descriptionZh: 加州各城市的租金上限、押金限额及必要披露要求各不相同，违规处罚切实存在。LeaseBase 统一追踪所有截止日期，并集中处理付款、维护及租赁事务。自信自主管理。
products.description: California rent caps, deposit limits, and required disclosures change by city — and the penalties are real. LeaseBase tracks every deadline and handles payments, maintenance, and leases in one place. Self-manage with confidence.

products.name: Mascofast
products.tagline: text to animated mascot in minutes
products.summaryZh: 几分钟内将文本转化为动画吉祥物
products.descriptionZh: MascoFast将简单创意转化为适用于应用、游戏或SaaS产品的生产级吉祥物。生成独特角色，优化外观，创建姿势和动画，并导出透明素材，直接用于界面、引导流程、营销及产品体验——全部集成于一个对开发者友好的工作流中。
products.description: MascoFast turns a simple idea into a production-ready mascot for your app, game, or SaaS product. Generate a distinctive character, refine its look, create poses and animations, and export transparent assets ready for your UI, onboarding, marketing, and product experiences—all in one developer-friendly workflow.

products.name: ConscioussAI
products.tagline: AI that runs your phone and computer
products.summaryZh: AI，掌控你的手机与电脑
products.descriptionZh: Consciouss AI是一款AI代理，不仅回答问题，还能为你执行任务。它能进行研究、浏览网页、创建文档、管理消息、规划行程、在线购物，并在你的批准下完成复杂工作流程。无需在多个应用和工具之间切换，只需告诉Consciouss你的需求，它就能完成工作。支持Mac、Windows、iOS和Android平台。
products.description: Consciouss AI is an AI agent that executes tasks for you, not just answers questions. It researches, browses the web, creates documents, manages messages, plans trips, shops online and completes complex workflows with your approval. Instead of switching between multiple apps and tools, just tell Consciouss what you want and it gets the work done. Available on Mac, Windows, iOS and Android.

products.name: GitFig
products.tagline: Sync Figma with GitHub
products.summaryZh: 将Figma与GitHub同步
products.descriptionZh: GitFig 是一款 Figma 插件，支持 Figma 与 GitHub 之间的双向同步。它将版本控制工作流引入设计系统，使你能够在仓库中以 JSON 格式管理设计令牌、变量、样式及所有模式，并可直接在 Figma 内进行分支、提交和拉取请求操作。
products.description: GitFig is a Figma plugin that enables bi-directional sync between Figma and GitHub. It brings version control workflows to your design system, allowing you to manage design tokens, variables, styles, and every mode in your repos as JSON, with branches, commits and pull requests from inside Figma.

products.name: Fraime
products.tagline: Open source AI media generation platform
products.summaryZh: 开源AI媒体生成平台
products.descriptionZh: 开放视频模型可免费下载，但运行它们需要更多——构建提示词、管理流程。封闭平台将这些隐藏在付费墙后。Fraime为你代劳：读取你的硬件，选择适配模型，构建提示词，并生成媒体——通过简洁API或直接从你的编码代理经MCP调用。目录中每个模型均无条件免费使用，无许可陷阱。开源。当前支持视频，图像与音频即将推出。
products.description: Open video models are free to download. Running one takes more — structuring prompts, managing the pipeline. Closed platforms hide that behind a paywall. Fraime does it for you: reads your hardware, picks a model that fits, structures the prompt, and generates the media — via a plain API or straight from your coding agents over MCP. Every model in the catalog is unconditionally free to use, no license traps. Open source. Video now, image and audio next.

products.name: Sunday Club
products.tagline: One hand-picked product launch, every Monday
products.summaryZh: 每周一精选一款产品发布
products.descriptionZh: Sunday Club每周精选一份新品短名单，经人工审核。投票、讨论，关注背后的创作者。无算法，无连续打卡。每周一仅一份宁静版。
products.description: Sunday Club picks one weekly shortlist of new products, vetted by hand. Vote, discuss, and follow the makers behind them. No algorithm, no streaks. Just one calm edition every Monday.

products.name: Claimads.land
products.tagline: The live map where startups battle for advertising territory
products.summaryZh: 创业公司争夺广告版图的实时地图
products.descriptionZh: 一个实时互动的市场，让初创企业、创作者和品牌争夺数字广告领地。认领你的初始地块，分配预算扩张边界，并在实时地图上捍卫你的可见度。将标准的按点击付费转化为引人入胜、游戏化的广告牌领地控制。
products.description: A real-time, interactive marketplace where startups, creators, and brands compete for digital advertising territory. Claim your initial tile, allocate budget to expand your borders, and defend your visibility on a live map. Turn standard pay-per-click into engaging, gamified billboard land control.

products.name: EP–2350 FX–MIC
products.tagline: The programmable mic you can squeeze, shake & play
products.summaryZh: 可编程麦克风，支持挤压、摇晃与演奏。
products.descriptionZh: EP–2350 FX–MIC是一款独立手持式演出麦克风，内置效果器、4个板载采样和一个参数调制杆。直接从麦克风上塑造人声并触发采样。用你自己的声音填充四个采样槽，并通过简单的JSON文件构建自己的效果预设。将其连接到你的K.O. II，或直接插入任何设备设置中。
products.description: EP–2350 FX–MIC is a standalone handheld performance microphone with built-in fx, 4 on-board samples and a parameter modulation lever. shape your vocals and trigger samples straight from the mic. fill the four sample slots with your own sounds and build your own effect presets using a simple json file. hook it up to your K.O. II or plug it straight into any setup.

products.name: Houndly
products.tagline: Self-learning GTM copilot. Give a brain to your sales stack
products.summaryZh: 自学习GTM副驾。为你的销售技术栈装上大脑。
products.descriptionZh: Houndly是一款自我学习的GTM副驾驶。它从每一次回复、会议和销售通话中学习，以优化你的目标客户、沟通内容及后续行动，并据此执行。
products.description: Houndly is a self-learning GTM copilot. It learns from every reply, meeting and sales call to improve who you target, what you say and what you do next, then acts on it.
